title: Ungahlola Kanjani Isimo Se-Grant ye-SASSA
description: Izindlela eziningi zokuhlola isimo sesicelo se-grant ye-SASSA noma isimo sokukhokhelwa ku-inthanethi, nge-WhatsApp, nge-USSD code, noma esikhungweni se-SASSA.

contentBlocks.title: Ungahlola Kanjani Isimo Se-Grant ye-SASSA
contentBlocks.description: Kunezindlela eziningi zokuhlola isimo se-grant ye-SASSA — ku-inthanethi nge-SRD portal, nge-WhatsApp line, nge-USSD code, noma ubhekisise esikhungweni se-SASSA. Khetha indlela ehambelana nawe kangcono.

contentBlocks.text: Ungahlola isimo sesicelo se-grant ye-SASSA noma isimo sokukhokhelwa nganoma yisiphi salezi zindlela. Khetha leyo ehambelana nawe kangcono — zonke zikhombisa ulwazi olufanayo, ngakho akukho olungile noma olungileyo. I-SRD portal ku-inthanethi iyashesha kunazo zonke futhi ikunikeze ulwazi oluningi, kodwa uma unenkinga ngedatha noma ngezinhlelo, i-WhatsApp line noma i-USSD code isebenza kahle njalo.

Kufanele uhlolise isimo sakho njalo, hhayi kanye kuphela. I-grant eyamukelwe ingabhekana nezinkinga kamuva — ukuqinisekisa ebhange elibonakaliswe ngokungazeleli, ukubuyiselwa okubulalwe, noma ukubambezeleka okudinga ukunakwa. Ukubamba inkinga kusenesikhathi kunokuyithola ngosuku lokukhokhelwa, ngakho ukuhlola nyanga ngayinye kuthatha imizuzu embalwa futhi kuyakusindisa ekukhathazekeni okukhulu.
Vakashela ku-srd.sassa.gov.za. Faka inombolo yakho ye-ID nenombolo yocingo oyisebenzisile ngesikhathi sokucela. Uzothola i-OTP nge-SMS ukuze uvule isikhwama sokuhlola isimo.

Ngaphambi kuqala, qinisekisa ukuthi ucingo olufakile luyiloyo ehlanganisiwe nesicelo sakho. Uma ushintshe inombolo yocingo ngemva kokucela, i-OTP ngeke ikufinyelele — kulungise leyo ndaba kuqala ngenkathi yenguqulo 'shintsha inombolo yocingo', kungenjalo uzoba sendleleni yokuthola izicelo ezingafiki.
Gcina u-082 046 8553 kucingo lakho. Thumela 'SASSA' ukuze uqale. Landela imiyalelo ukuze uhlole ibhalansi, usuku lokukhokhelwa, noma isimo sesicelo. Imahhala kuzo inethiwekhi eziningi.

Le ndlela iyasesiza uma usese-WhatsApp nje. Imenyu yokuxoxisana ikuhola ngezinyathelo, futhi awudingi ukukhumbula noma yiziphi izinkombi noma aniyethi. Phendula nje ngenombolo yokhetho ofuna ukuyisebenzisa. Enye into okufanele ukhumbule: i-SASSA ngeke ikuthumelele umyalezo we-PIN noma i-OTP ngaphandle kokuthi uqale ngawe — qalisa nje ngokuthumela 'SASSA'.
Shaya *134*7737# kucingo lakho. Landela imenyu ukuze uhlole isimo se-grant yakho. Izinkokhelo ezijwayelekile zinethiwekhi zisebenza.

I-USSD indlela engcono yokubuyisela uma ucingo lwakho lungenawo amadatha noma uhlelo manje. Isebenza kumniningo, nangaphezu kwalo naluphi uhlobo lucingo. Izinkokhelo ezijwayelekile zinethiwekhi zisebenza, ngakho ayimahhala njenge-WhatsApp line — kodwa iyashibhile futhi isenza umsebenzi.
Letha i-ID yakho esikhungweni ngasinye se-SASSA sendawo. Umsebenzisi angakuhlola isimo sakho futhi akunikeze isisetshenziswa uma kunesidingo.

Uma ukuhlola ku-inthanethi kungasebenzi futhi usecinde esikhungweni, leyo ndlela ekahle yokubuyisela. Yaqala ekuseni bese uletha incwadi ye-ID noma i-smart card yakho. Ezinye izikhungo manje zinekhasi lokusebenza ngokwakho lapho ungahlola isimo sakho ngokuthinta isikrini ngaphandle kokulinda umsebenzisi — buza abasebenzi esikhungweni esisedu kunakho konke uma kukhona leli khasi.

contentBlocks.title: Zonke Izindlela Zikhombisa Isimo Esifanayo
contentBlocks.text: I-portal, i-WhatsApp, i-USSD, nesikhungo se-SASSA zifunda esistimu esifanayo. Uma indlela ethile ikhombisa 'Isilindile' nezinye zikhombisa okuhlukile, thembelesi umphumela omusha ubeke insuku ezimbili noma ezintathu — izistimu zihlanganisa kahle.

faqs.question: Kungani isimo sami sibonakala 'Sisilindile' ngemva kwamasonto?
faqs.answer: 'Isilindile' kusho ukuthi isicelo sakho siyaqhubeka nokuhlolwa futhi akukho isinqumo esenziwe. Singahlala njalo isikhathi eside ngesikhathi esivumelanisiwe, ikakhulukazi ngesikhathi sokubuyiselwa. Qhubeka uhlola, futhi uma kukade izinsuku eziyi-90, xhumana ne-SASSA ku-0800 60 10 11 ukuze uthole ukuvuselela.

faqs.question: Ngiqhubeka nthola iphutha uma ngizama ukungena ku-SRD portal. Manje?
faqs.answer: Zama ezinye izindlela — i-WhatsApp line (082 046 8553) noma i-USSD *134*7737#. Uma nalezi zingasebenzi, ungasalela esikhungweni se-SASSA noma usho ku-0800 60 10 11. Amaphutha okungena ku-portal avamise ukuba okwesikhashana, ngakho ukususa ifayili yesipheqululho bese uzama futhi kamuva kusizayo.

faqs.question: Ngidinga idatha ukuze ngihlole isimo ngise-WhatsApp?
faqs.answer: I-WhatsApp line ye-SASSA imahhala kuzo inethiwekhi eziningi, kuhlanganisa nezinhlelo ezingekhozedatha kusuka kubaphathi abakhulu. Uma ukhathazeka ngedatha, i-USSD code *134*7737# indlela enye ehambelana noma yisiphi iselula, nakuba izinkokhelo ezijwayelekile zingasebenza.

faqs.question: Umuntu ongahlola isimo sami esikhundleni sami?
faqs.answer: Inombolo yakho ye-ID ne-inombolo yocingo ehlanganisiwe kuphela edingekile ku-portal, ngakho ilungu lemndeni elinale mininingwane lingena ku-akhawunti yakho. Uma uvumela umuntu ozokusiza ukusebenzise ikhasi noma ubuze umhloli we-SASSA esikhundleni sakho, ungakaze wabelane nge-OTP yakho — futhi ubekezele kakhulu ngobani omthembayo nge-ID ne-inombolo yocingo.
